mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the non-resident parent/holding company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry in the jurisdiction of incorporation of the parent company (e.g., Registrar of Companies, Companies Commission, or equivalent national registry)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize the certificate in the parent company's home jurisdiction. If that jurisdiction is a contracting state to the Hague Convention of 5 October 1961, obtain one Apostille certificate from the designated competent authority and submit it together with the notarized original; do NOT add consular legalization. If the home jurisdiction is not an Apostille-contracting state, present the notarized document to the Chinese Embassy or Consulate having jurisdiction for consular legalization; do NOT add an Apostille. The two paths are parallel and mutually exclusive and must never be chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Incumbency for the parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or licensed corporate services provider in the parent company's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize the certificate at origin. If the origin state is a Hague Apostille member, obtain a single Apostille from the designated competent authority. If not, obtain consular legalization from the Chinese Embassy/Consulate in the origin state. Use only one method; never combine Apostille and consular legalization sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution or Power of Attorney authorizing the establishment of the WFOE and the appointment of its legal representative and sole director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors (or equivalent governing body) of the non-resident parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Legalize the certified extract of the resolution/PoA in the parent company's home jurisdiction. For Hague member states, apply an Apostille from the local designated competent authority. For non-member states, use consular legalization at the Chinese Embassy/Consulate with jurisdiction. These paths are alternatives and may not be combined sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association or constitutional document of the non-resident parent company (extract showing authorized signatories and capital structure)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry of companies or notary public in the parent company's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize an official extract at origin, then either (a) obtain an Apostille if the origin state has acceded to the Apostille Convention, or (b) obtain consular legalization if the origin state is a non-member. Apostille and consular legalization are mutually exclusive and cannot appear together in the same chain.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate bank reference letter concerning the parent company's business history and banking relationships
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Parent company's corporate bank in its country of operation or incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize the bank officer's signature and bank seal at origin. If the origin country is a Hague Apostille state, attach one Apostille. If the origin country is a non-member, complete consular legalization at the Chinese Embassy/Consulate in that country. The selected path is exclusive; the alternative method must not be appended.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before any WFOE documentation is executed, the law firm must screen every ultimate beneficial owner, director, legal representative, authorized signatory, and material shareholder against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the OFAC SDN and Non-SDN sanctions lists, the European Union consolidated financial sanctions list, the United Kingdom OFSI sanctions list, and domestic Chinese public security and PBOC adverse lists. Enhanced continuous screening includes negative news monitoring and politically exposed person (PEP) classification; each natural person must provide certified copy of passport, proof of address, and source of funds declaration. All screening results and risk-based determinations must be recorded in written minutes and preserved for at least five years. Because the entity is a manufacturing WFOE in the low-risk toy/educational segment, a standard (non-enhanced) due diligence level applies, but automatic adverse-media alerts and transaction monitoring flags are still mandatory.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Integrated Enterprise Registration and Enterprise Name Self-Declaration System
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The WFOE must adopt a Chinese-only statutory name composed of four tiers in the following order: (1) administrative division at or above county level; (2) a distinctive trade name or the approved phonetic transliteration of the foreign parent's name; (3) an industry or business characteristic description, such as WOODEN TOYS, PUZZLE LASER ASSEMBLY, or EDUCATIONAL TOYS; and (4) the legal form suffix LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY or LIMITED. Only simplified Chinese characters are accepted in the SAMR system; any English, pinyin, or foreign-script name is used only as an unofficial trade name and does not replace the registered Chinese name. Local registration authorities require that the distinctive part not duplicate or resemble existing registered names within the same administrative area and that the pinyin transliteration of a foreign investor's trademark be shown in the name declaration where the foreign name is used.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the SAMR name declaration is rejected, the applicant must first obtain the written or on-screen rejection reason from the responsible district-level registry (or provincial SAMR for centrally administered names). The investor may file an administrative reconsideration application with the market regulatory authority one level above the rejecting office within 60 calendar days of receiving the rejection; alternatively, the investor may re-declare a corrected name immediately. If the reconsideration authority upholds the rejection, the applicant may bring administrative litigation in the competent people's court within six months. For a simple name similarity refusal, the prompt new-declaration path should be used without appeal. For a politically sensitive token refusal, the appeal must include the authenticated Board Resolution/PoA and a Chinese-language explanation of the business purpose. Because the SAMR name reservation window is 30 days, a backup name should be reserved concurrently while any appeal is pending.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For this precise ISIC 3240 / NAICS 339930 business (precision CO2 laser cutting and assembly of three-dimensional mechanical wooden puzzles), a virtual office, commercial mailbox, or shared service address will be rejected by local SAMR branch offices, taxation authorities, customs, and the banks required for Amazon Pay and Stripe settlement. The WFOE must maintain a dedicated physical registered office in the same city as the manufacturing site or, at minimum, a registered office where the legal representative can be personally served and where books, fixed assets, payroll records, and operational machinery can be inspected. The tax bureau will deny VAT and business premises place-of-use registration for purely virtual addresses; the bank will decline to open a corporate current account if the lease is a sublease or a virtual office package. Therefore, the applicant should procure a direct lease or a fully legalized sublease from the property owner, together with the property ownership certificate (real estate certificate), for a term of at least one year.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: (1) Lease agreement registered with the municipal housing authority; (2) real estate ownership certificate or legal sublease authorization; (3) physical presence of laser cutting equipment and assembly workstations matching the declared scope; (4) operational power and fire-safety records; (5) payroll and social insurance contribution lists; (6) inventory and raw-material purchase invoices; (7) on-site safety signs and waste disposal contracts; and (8) a signboard bearing the exact SAMR-registered Chinese company name. Quantified risk: 45% likelihood within the first 12 months of registration for a manufacturing WFOE, increasing to 60% if the declared address is in a residential or mixed-use building or if the company applies for export VAT rebates. Unannounced inspections are typically conducted by district market regulation officers in coordination with municipal tax inspectors, and failure to have the registered legal representative or a responsible officer present may trigger temporary suspension of VAT invoices and rectification notices.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024), Articles 7, 16, 23, 24, 26, 28, 35, 47, 51 and 52; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Articles 4, 10, 28 and 31; Implementing Regulations of the Foreign Investment Law (2020); Special Administrative Measures for Foreign Investment Access (Negative List) (2021 Edition).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation; registration is completed through the local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation, Enterprise Registration Division, or the National Enterprise Registration Online Portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Company Establishment Registration, submitted together with the Articles of Association, the Notice of Pre-Approval of Enterprise Name and the registered-office proof, resulting in the issuance of the Business License with Unified Social Credit Code.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None (no statutory minimum registered capital for a WFOE limited liability company), but registered capital must be stated in the Articles of Association and subscribed by the sole shareholder. Contributions must be made within the statutory five-year capital payment period unless an express shorter schedule applies, and paid-in capital must be remitted into the company's FDI capital account through an authorized bank after SAFE foreign-exchange receipt registration. A state-run blocked escrow account is not required for a general manufacturing WFOE; however, the settlement bank will impose purpose checks and capital may be released to current-operations accounts only after foreign-investment information reporting and payment authentication according to applicable exchange control rules.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS RESOLUTION. The Board of Directors of the Company, convened in a duly constituted meeting on the date indicated below, adopted the following resolutions. WHEREAS the Company was incorporated as a wholly foreign-owned limited liability company under the laws of the People's Republic of China; and WHEREAS the shareholders have adopted Articles of Association authorizing the Board to implement all matters necessary to commence operations; and WHEREAS the Board deems it in the best interests of the Company to establish its share capital, banking relationships, registered office, and statutory officer positions. NOW THEREFORE, it is resolved as follows: 1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION. The registered capital of the Company, as set forth in the Articles of Association, is hereby ratified and accepted in full. The sole shareholder shall subscribe to all shares or equity interests on a schedule not exceeding the statutory contribution period. The directors and the legal representative are jointly authorized to open a capital contribution account, to receive capital remittances and to issue capital contribution receipts

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA), acting through the local competent State Tax Bureau of the WFOE's place of incorporation, with online filing and registration through the National Electronic Tax Bureau (electronic tax bureau portal: etax.chinatax.gov.cn; principal STA portal: chinatax.gov.cn).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Upon incorporation, the Administration for Market Regulation issues an 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (USCC); the USCC is the sole statutory taxpayer identification number (TIN) and VAT registration number for the WFOE. No separate VAT ID is issued. The market-registration information is automatically shared with the STA, and the WFOE must complete the tax registration information confirmation in the Electronic Tax Bureau within the prescribed post-incorporation period (generally within 30 days of obtaining the business license), declaring taxpayer type, financial-accounting standards, bank account, legal representative and business scope. The local STA then confirms VAT taxpayer status, invoice capability, and records the export tax rebate (exemption) registration for the WFOE before export zero-rating can be claimed. For physical exports, the WFOE must separately obtain the GACC customs registration code as an import/export goods consignee/consignor through the China International Trade Single Window. For foreign non-resident entities that have no Chinese permanent establishment but receive Chinese-source payments from the WFOE, the WFOE as withholding agent must register each non-resident enterprise with the STA in the e-tax system and obtain a non-resident enterprise tax registration number for withholding purposes; this non-resident registration does not change the WFOE's own entity-level tax classification.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election or hybrid-mismatch election is available under PRC tax law; the WFOE is mandatorily an entity-level Enterprise Income Tax (EIT) taxpayer and a VAT taxpayer. The relevant elections are limited to: (i) a small-scale VAT taxpayer with annual taxable sales below the RMB 5,000,000 threshold may voluntarily register as a general VAT taxpayer if accounting and tax-control systems are adequate; (ii) where expressly permitted by VAT rules, a taxpayer may elect simplified VAT levy methods for specified services; and (iii) under the EIT law, certain accelerated depreciation or prescribed accounting elections may be available for qualifying fixed assets. Hybrid and other anti-avoidance rules apply.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the PRC VAT system; a national multi-stage VAT on taxable goods and services supplied in China, with zero-rating for qualifying exports.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 5,000,000 aggregate VAT-taxable sales in a rolling 12-month period; exceeding this threshold makes VAT general taxpayer registration mandatory. A taxpayer below the threshold is a small-scale taxpayer but may elect general VAT taxpayer status voluntarily.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: VAT invoices must be issued through STA-approved electronic tax invoice systems; general taxpayers issue Special VAT Invoices or fully digitalized electronic invoices, with invoice data transmitted in near real time to the STA's Golden Tax Phase IV system. Each invoice carries a unique invoice number, the taxpayer's USCC, item description, rate, amount and an anti-counterfeit two-dimensional code. Input VAT deduction requires the recipient to verify and confirm the invoice online in the VAT invoice selection platform before crediting input VAT. The fully digitalized electronic invoice reform permits qualifying taxpayers to operate without physical Tax Ukey devices, but the digital invoices must still be issued through the national unified electronic invoice service platform and cleared electronically in real time. For exports, an export sales invoice referencing the customs export declaration number must be retained and filed in the electronic tax bureau export rebate system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: To claim the 0% export VAT rate, the WFOE must be a PRC VAT general taxpayer with valid export tax rebate (exemption) registration. The wooden puzzles must be physically exported from the customs territory of China to an overseas destination, declared to the General Administration of Customs (GACC) under the applicable export commodity code (HS 9503.00 for puzzles), and cleared by customs. The WFOE must retain an accepted Customs Export Declaration, transport documents proving physical departure, the commercial invoice and contract with an overseas buyer, and bank-verified evidence of repatriation of the export sales proceeds in foreign currency through a SAFE-designated bank. For cross-border e-commerce sales, platform order data, Amazon Pay or Stripe settlement statements, delivery records and customs export data must be consistent. The export zero-rating operates through the exemption-and-refund mechanism: output VAT on the export is zero and attributable input VAT is refunded. Qualifying offshore digital services are zero-rated only where the statutory cross-border services list is met and delivery/use occurs wholly outside China; the WFOE's core scope here is physical goods.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Export Bill of Entry) accepted by the General Administration of Customs, declaring the export commodity code HS 9503.00 and the applicable customs supervision/export trade mode (e.g., 9610, 9710 or 9810 for eligible cross-border e-commerce export models)
Bill of Lading or equivalent multimodal/air transport document proving the goods physically departed China from a Chinese customs port to the overseas destination
Commercial invoice, packing list and export sales contract or overseas purchase order

Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) or bank foreign exchange income voucher issued by the PRC settlement bank under SAFE, evidencing receipt and repatriation of the export proceeds in foreign currency
Export tax refund (exemption) declaration data filed in the STA Electronic Tax Bureau and the export sales invoice referencing the corresponding customs export declaration number
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA, GACC and SAFE cross-check export declaration data, invoice data, logistics events, platform settlement data and bank foreign-exchange receipts under the Golden Tax Phase IV system. If a claimed export is found to be false, not physically exported, misdeclared in value, supported by forged documentation, or lacking bank-verified foreign-exchange repatriation within the applicable deadline (generally 180 days unless a lawful extension has been filed before the deadline), the export zero-rating is disallowed and any VAT refund already paid is clawed back. The taxpayer may also be subject to a daily late-payment surcharge on underpaid tax, an administrative fine of 50% to five times the tax or refund improperly obtained, suspension or revocation of export tax rebate qualification, and criminal liability under PRC tax criminal provisions for fraudulent export tax refunds or false issuance of special VAT invoices, with penalties ranging from fines and imprisonment to life imprisonment for extremely large amounts.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a hybrid convertibility regime. The current account is broadly convertible for trade in goods and services, allowing a qualifying WFOE to receive export payments and settle invoices in RMB subject to transaction authenticity reviews by designated FX banks and SAFE's Trade in Goods Monitoring System. The capital account remains heavily controlled: a WFOE's paid-in registered capital arriving from foreign investors must be registered with SAFE through the Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) registration system, and each inbound remittance must carry a clear purpose code and be credited to a capital settlement account after completing FDI registration. Conversion of that capital into RMB is permitted only for genuine operating purposes such as procurement, salaries, rent, and VAT payment; prohibited activities include domestic equity investment, securities investments in RMB, and real estate purchases beyond the company's actual premises. Dividend and profit remittance abroad is lawful for after-tax profits but requires annual audit financial statements, corporate income tax settlement documents, withholding tax payment certificates for non-resident shareholders, and bank verification that funds originated from registered capital or accumulated operating profits and not from domestic borrowing. Surplus conversion proceeds are monitored and must be used within the approved business scope. Therefore, fund repatriation, intercompany loans, and capital injections require multi-party documentary evidence and cannot be executed via unlicensed digital cross-border platforms.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds from wooden puzzle goods must be repatriated to China within 180 days of the date of Customs export declaration; the statutory repatriation ratio is 100% of the invoice value net of bank charges. Once credited to the domestic current account foreign exchange settlement account, the WFOE may retain the foreign currency or sell it to the bank for RMB. No mandatory conversion ratio applies under the current post-2012 framework, but SAFE and the designated bank require full supporting documentation under the goods trade verification system within 30 days of receipt, including customs declarations, commercial invoices, bills of lading, and marketplace payout statements if sold through cross-border e-commerce.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Settlement Account / FDI Registration Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low viability for primary treasury use. China's foreign exchange law does not recognize offshore EMI or neobank e-money licenses as valid FX settlement institutions; only banks designated by SAFE and licensed domestic non-bank payment institutions may handle cross-border trade receipts. Offshore fintech EMIs cannot provide domestic RMB clearing, SAFE FDI registration, or capital account verification. They may support collection payouts from Amazon and Stripe into an intermediate USD account, but final net proceeds must be routed to a domestic designated FX bank via SWIFT MT103 with the correct SAFE FX purpose code. Thus, an offshore EMI is acceptable only as a conduit collection tool, not as a corporate bank account or liquidity rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For WFOE account opening, SAFE-approved banks uniformly require the legal representative and at least one financial controller to attend a physical in-branch interview, sign operational protocols, and present original reusable KYC files. Remote consular notarized powers of attorney are accepted only for supplementary signers, not for statutory representative verification. Some banks offer a hybrid video interview, but a physical visit remains mandatory for first capital account activation and FX derivative eligibility certification. Therefore, plan in-country director travel and in-person board attendance during onboarding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial ownership of the foreign parent is non-transparent due to offshore intermediate holding companies or nominee shareholders.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide certified copies of the certificate of incorporation, articles of association, and shareholder register for every direct shareholder; a signed UBO declaration mapping every natural person holding more than 25%; current passports and proof of residential address for all UBOs and directors; a board resolution authorising the WFOE formation and bank account; a chartered accountant source-of-funds and source-of-wealth report for initial capital; and a sworn affidavit confirming no bearer shares or undisclosed nominee holdings.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Export invoice valuation mismatches due to Amazon Pay and Stripe net settlement fees, refunds, and currency conversion adjustments triggering trade-based money laundering review.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: For each export settlement, provide commercial invoices, packing lists, Customs export declaration forms, bill of lading or air waybill, payment notification from the marketplace, marketplace payout statement, refund and exchange ledger, insurance certificate, and an ISIC 3240 product classification memo. Reconcile gross invoice value to net proceeds with a complete fee breakdown and conversion report.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection from the overseas parent is not matched to FDI registration and may violate capital account use restrictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit the SAFE FDI registration certificate and MOFCOM filing receipt; a funding commitment letter from the parent board; the parent's audited financial statements for the latest two years; legal representative certification; bank proof of share remittance; an expected capital payment schedule; and a self-declaration that proceeds will cover only permitted operating expenses such as payroll, rent, raw materials, and domestic value-added tax.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Potential mismatch between reported business activities and the statutory WFOE business scope; laser cutting toy manufacturing may trigger product safety or export control review.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the updated business license with the unified social credit code reflecting ISIC 3240 and NAICS 339930; Customs import and export registration certificate; product technical descriptions and EN71/ASTM F963 safety compliance certificates; end-customer distribution agreements; a written statement confirming no dual-use or laser export restrictions; and local regulatory approval certificates if applicable.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The overseas parent must transfer USD from its home bank via SWIFT MT103 to the WFOE's designated capital settlement account at a Tier-1 domestic commercial bank. The remittance must reference the SAFE BOP transaction code family for direct investment capital contribution, commonly the 602xxx series, and the bank will validate the exact leaf code during FDI registration against SAFE records. The bank executes pre-credit screening, obtains the capital settlement account confirmation, and verifies that the remittance sender matches the registered foreign investor. After posting, the WFOE submits the capital verification report, the FDI business license, the board capital injection resolution, and the source-of-funds dossier; only then may the bank convert eligible portions to RMB for operating uses within the approved scope. Capital account funds cannot be used for equity transfers, entrusted loans, or speculative financial instruments.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements should use SWIFT MT103 for intercompany disbursements and high-volume payments; commercial letters of credit (sight or usance) for large buyer-contract exports requiring bank payment guarantees; and documentary collections under D/P or D/A terms for established counterparties. For Amazon Pay and Stripe marketplace transactions, the WFOE should maintain a dedicated cross-border e-commerce collection account at a designated bank that receives USD in bulk from the payment service provider, verifies individual order-level transaction records, and then applies the current account conversion rate to RMB. All outbound disbursement messages must include the WFOE's tax ID, contract or PO number, product HS code, and clear narrative describing the wooden puzzle laser assembly goods to avoid trade verification holds.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Bank-sponsored RMB/USD FX forward contracts with a real trade background and tenor aligned to actual export receivables, typically up to 12 months
Ordinary currency swaps with SAFE-approved banks for underlying commercial transactions, not for speculative leverage
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permissible for onshore WFOEs; NDF use is confined to offshore non-resident counterparties
FX options are permitted only as risk-reducing hedging tools with a physical delivery requirement and must be documented against export order commitments

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Enterprise Annual Report for Market Entities (including the integrated Foreign-Invested Enterprise Annual Investment Information Report and annual confirmation of Beneficial Owner Information) filed through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the local market regulation administration; data shared with the Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM), Ministry of Finance, and State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 through June 30 of the current year, covering the immediately preceding calendar year; no discretionary extension is available to a private WFOE
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or non-filing causes the WFOE to be placed on the Public List of Enterprises with Abnormal Operations within 10 working days after June 30; the WFOE must apply for removal after rectifying the omission. If non-compliance continues for three years, the WFOE is moved to the Serious Illegal and Untrustworthy Enterprise List, triggering joint disciplinary measures and enhanced inspection. Submission of false or concealed annual-report information is punishable by a fine of up to RMB 10,000, and the responsible persons may be separately fined. Administrative revocation is not automatic for annual-report delinquency alone, but continuation with tax non-compliance or a 6-month period of non-operation entitles the registration authority to revoke the business license under the PRC Company Law.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Final Settlement Return for enterprise income tax, together with the audited annual financial statements and related-party transaction schedules required by the tax filing package
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) through the tax bureau with jurisdiction over the WFOE's registered address
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before May 31 of the following calendar year, being within five months after the December 31 fiscal year-end; a nil-return filing is still mandatory where the WFOE has no taxable income
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers an order to file within a specified period and a fine of RMB 2,000, or RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 for serious cases, under the Tax Collection and Administration Law. Underpaid tax is subject to a late-payment surcharge of 0.05% per calendar day from the original deadline. If under-reporting is characterized as tax evasion, the additional penalty is 50% to 5 times the underpaid tax; serious tax evasion may lead to criminal prosecution and possible revocation of the business license.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory audit of the annual financial statements by a licensed Chinese accounting firm, and submission of the signed audit report to the shareholders for approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders' meeting of the WFOE; the signed audit report and tax reconciliation must be preserved for inspection by SAMR, STA, SAFE, and the local commerce authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Before the annual shareholders' meeting that approves the financial statements, and in any event before the June 30 annual-report deadline where audited figures are used in the SAMR annual report; prudent practice sets a target of completion by April 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to have the annual accounts audited is a breach of the PRC Company Law; directors and officers may bear civil liability for losses caused thereby. The WFOE may be unable to support tax final settlement, SAFE profit repatriation, cross-border financing, or deregistration. The financial statements may be rejected by the shareholders, and continued non-compliance can be treated as unlawful management by regulatory authorities.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign-invested enterprise annual information report, including FDI operation statistics and ultimate beneficial owner information
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) through the SAMR National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System; SAFE receives the foreign-direct-investment statistics module
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same statutory annual-report window: January 1 through June 30 for the preceding calendar year; changes in foreign investment status that make the filed annual report inaccurate must be corrected promptly after the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Missing or erroneous foreign investment information is treated as a failure to report under the Foreign Investment Law; the WFOE may be ordered to rectify, included on the abnormal-operations list, and may face restrictions on future cross-border capital registration and profit repatriation, as well as administrative fines for concealment or misrepresentation.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No balance-sheet, turnover, or headcount threshold exists to exempt a China WFOE limited liability company from the annual statutory audit requirement. Under the PRC Company Law, every company is required to have the annual financial accounting report audited by a certified public accounting firm in China. A private WFOE with zero revenue must still engage a registered CPA firm and obtain an audit report. If the WFOE is part of a group that triggers enterprise income tax related-party disclosure, the annual filing must include related-party transaction reporting and contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation, but this does not replace the statutory audit. Additional compulsory audits also apply where the entity seeks SAFE foreign-exchange annual inspection, applies for licenses, participates in government tenders, or is in the process of equity transfer or liquidation.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (Chinese GAAP/ASBE), which are substantially converged with IFRS; small-scale enterprises may apply the Simplified Accounting Standards for Small Enterprises only if they meet the applicable small-enterprise size criteria and file a note on the chosen framework, but the statutory financial statements must still be audited. The consolidation pack for the overseas parent may be prepared under IFRS or US GAAP, but the Chinese statutory WFOE accounts, audit opinion, and tax filings must be maintained in RMB under Chinese GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Beneficial Owner Information Administration Measures effective November 1, 2024, a WFOE must identify every natural person who ultimately owns or controls the entity through direct or indirect equity, voting rights, or control mechanisms, and must report their identity and method of control to SAMR through the enterprise registration system. A WFOE incorporated after November 1, 2024 must make the initial filing within 30 days of establishment; a WFOE existing before November 1, 2024 must complete the initial filing before November 1, 2025. Any change in beneficial ownership, including a shareholding transfer that changes a 25% or greater beneficial interest or changes control, must be reported within 30 days of the change. In addition, the annual Enterprise Annual Report serves as the required annual confirmation that the beneficial owner information remains complete and correct; no separate annual UBO form is due where no change has occurred in the preceding calendar year, but the annual report module must confirm the information.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Senior Management Personnel and Company Secretary (if any)
Register of Charges/Mortgages and Other Security Interests over Company Assets
Minute Book of Shareholders' Resolutions and Board Resolutions
Financial Accounting Books and Audit File

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 - USD 1,200 per year for licensed corporate secretarial and registered agent support outside first-tier city premiums; USD 600 - USD 2,000 per year when a physical registered-address service in Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou or Shenzhen is included
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 - USD 6,000 per year for a manufacturing WFOE with modest intercompany transactions, depending on fixed assets, inventory levels, related-party flows, transfer pricing documentation needs, and CPA firm tier

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: China's enterprise income tax headline rate is 25%. Preferential regimes include: (a) certified High and New Technology Enterprises (HNTE) subject to a reduced 15% rate; (b) small and low-profit enterprises with annual taxable income not exceeding RMB 3 million, employees up to 300, and total assets up to RMB 50 million may enjoy effective reduced rates; (c) 100% additional deduction for qualifying R&D expenses of manufacturing enterprises; (d) accelerated depreciation for certain fixed assets. For a WFOE in precision CO2 laser cutting and assembly of wooden puzzles, actual production substance and qualifying R&D records must be maintained to access these incentives.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: A100000 Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return (Form A) for Resident Enterprises, filed with the State Taxation Administration (STA) through the Electronic Tax Bureau eTax portal using the entity's unified social credit code.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (with quarterly provisional corporate income tax filings during the year)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return must be filed no later than 31 May of the year following the calendar tax year; quarterly provisional returns are due within 15 days after the end of each quarter. The final tax payment is settled simultaneously with the annual return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all sales revenue recognized in China from global sales of laser-cut 3D wooden puzzles, including Amazon marketplace and direct B2B export sales routed through the WFOE. For transactions with related parties, ensure the revenue booked equals the arm's length amount applied in contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation; reverse any erroneous revenue attributed to a foreign permanent establishment properly allocated abroad under treaty rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating Costs (cost of goods sold and services)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include raw timber, laser consumables, packaging, and direct assembly labor. If the WFOE purchases wood panels or semi-finished components from a related foreign supplier, the cost must be tested under the Comparable Uncontrolled Price or Transactional Net Margin Method and supported by invoices, customs declarations, and bank settlement records. Unsupported related-party markups will be adjusted by the tax authority.

Report VAT surcharges, urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharges, and property tax. VAT collected on exports should be reconciled with export rebate schedules; do not include income tax or deduct VAT input credits in this line.

Disclose Amazon marketplace referral fees, warehousing fees, freight, advertising, and platform commissions. Retain platform payout reports and settlement statements. Any intercompany marketing or distribution fee paid to a foreign related party must satisfy economic substance and arm's length benefit tests.

Include management, legal, accounting, and office costs. Management fees charged by the overseas parent are deductible only if the parent actually rendered services and the fee is not a disguised profit transfer under STA Public Notice 42 (2016) and STA Announcement 16/2011. Retain service agreements and evidence of tangible benefit.

Include bank charges, foreign exchange losses, and interest expense on intercompany loans. Interest paid to a non-resident shareholder may be subject to thin-capitalization rules (debt-to-equity ratio 2:1, or 5:1 for financial institutions) and withholding tax. Excess interest exceeding the arm's length base is non-deductible and may be recharacterized as deemed dividend.

Report accounting impairment losses on receivables, inventory, and fixed assets. Such losses are deductible for tax purposes only if supported by evidence and within the limits prescribed by STA rules; losses on related-party receivables require special scrutiny and may be disallowed absent genuine collection procedures.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gains or Losses from Changes in Fair Value
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For derivative instruments held by the WFOE, report unrealized fair value movements per accounting standards. Taxable basis may differ; reconcile in the tax adjustment schedule. Hedging transactions with the foreign parent require proper contracts and business justification.

Report dividends, interest, and securities gains. Dividends from Chinese resident enterprises are exempt; foreign-source income may be reported separately to claim foreign tax credits. If the WFOE serves as the foreign parent's manufacturing investment vehicle, the foreign parent's dividend income from the WFOE is not reported here; only the WFOE's own investment income belongs on this line.

Include government grants, fines recovered, insurance compensation, and miscellaneous business income. Government subsidies should be classified as taxable or non-taxable with supporting documents; export VAT rebates are not included in taxable income.

This is the accounting operating profit after all operating line items above. For a WFOE with intercompany pricing adjustments, ensure this figure mirrors the final audited financial statements; any discrepancy should be disclosed in the tax adjustment schedule.

Include income unrelated to core operations, such as disposal of fixed assets or donation receipts. Non-resident shareholders should not route service income through this line; misclassification may trigger deemed dividend analysis.

Include philanthropic donations, asset write-offs, and penalties. Donations to affiliated entities or payments to foreign governing bodies are deductible only if made through approved charitable channels; punitive fines and damages are non-deductible.
This equals Line 11 plus Line 12 minus Line 13. It must match the audited accounting net profit before tax. All tax adjustments begin from this accounting total profit.

Report all permanent and temporary differences that increase taxable income, including disallowed entertainment expenses, non-deductible related-party charges, excess interest or royalties, and transfer pricing adjustments proposed by the tax authority. The WFOE should proactively make self-adjustments in the related-party transaction schedule to avoid penalties.

Report items that reduce taxable income, such as previously over-reported depreciation or deductible losses carried forward. Make sure any decrease is supported by tax filing positions and documentation. Use of prior-year tax losses must be tracked in the tax loss schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Less: Tax-Exempt Income, Reduced Income and Additional Deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report interest on national bonds, qualified innovative investment income, and R&D additional deductions. For a laser puzzle manufacturer, R&D expenses for optimizing laser cutting parameters and equipment automation may be claimed for a 100% additional deduction; keep contemporaneous R&D project records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add: Overseas Income and Foreign Tax Credit
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the WFOE earns foreign-source income from overseas sales offices or remote services, disclose the foreign-source income and foreign taxes paid. The foreign tax credit is limited to the Chinese tax payable on that overseas income and cannot exceed the total Chinese tax on the same income.

This is the adjusted taxable base after applying all legal adjustments. For a WFOE, the taxable income must not be manipulated through exaggerated management fees, royalties, or interest paid to the foreign parent; otherwise, the tax authority may apply the General Anti-Avoidance Rules and transfer pricing rules to recharacterize the base.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable Tax Rate and Tax Payable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the 25% standard rate, or 15% for HNTE, or effective reduced rates for small low-profit enterprises where eligible. Calculate preliminary tax payable, then deduct tax reductions, credits, and pre-payments. Any underpayment discovered during the annual settlement must be paid by 31 May.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file quarterly or annual returns in time: fixed penalty from RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 (increased to RMB 10,000 to RMB 50,000 in serious cases) under Article 62 of the Tax Collection Administration Law (TCAL); overdue tax attracts a daily surcharge of 0.05% of the unpaid tax under Article 32; false or fraudulent filing constitutes tax evasion under Article 63, subject to a monetary penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax, and criminal prosecution under Article 201 of the Criminal Law for amounts exceeding criminal thresholds, with aggravated penalties for export-rebate fraud under Article 204.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% withholding tax on dividends paid by the WFOE to its non-resident foreign shareholder under Articles 3 and 37 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law (EITL), unless the rate is reduced under an applicable Double Taxation Agreement (commonly 5% for shareholding of at least 25% and subject to beneficial ownership requirements).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim DTA relief, the WFOE as withholding agent must before each distribution: (a) obtain a current Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the foreign shareholder's tax authority covering the dividend payment date; (b) prepare a beneficial ownership declaration showing the shareholder is the ultimate recipient, has economic substance, and does not engage in treaty shopping; (c) file a withholding tax return and the treaty relief application with the competent State Taxation Administration office, attaching the WFOE's constitutional documents, shareholding register, dividend resolution, and foreign exchange payment record; and (d) submit the application online through the eTax portal or physical counterpart in the jurisdiction where the WFOE is registered. The tax authority may deny treaty benefits if the shareholder fails the Principal Purpose Test under BEPS Action 6 or lacks substance to receive the dividend. Withholding must be made and paid by the WFOE within 15 days of the dividend payment date; late remittance triggers surcharges and penalties.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding on outbound interest and royalties is 10% under the EITL. Under typical Chinese DTAs, interest may be reduced to 5% or 7% depending on the treaty partner and beneficial owner, and royalties to 5-10%; in all cases, a TRC and beneficial ownership substantiation are mandatory. Royalty payments for the use of intellectual property in China must be deducted at source at 10% plus VAT (6% on licensing services) unless a zero-rating or exemption applies. Intercompany interest deductions are further capped by thin-capitalization ratios and arm's length interest rate benchmarks.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File preparation is triggered when annual related-party transactions exceed RMB 200 million for tangible asset transfers, RMB 100 million for intangible property transfers, RMB 100 million for financial transactions, or RMB 40 million for other related-party transactions. Master File preparation is compulsory where the enterprise's total annual related-party transaction amount exceeds RMB 1 billion. In all cases, a Related Party Transaction Reporting Form must be filed with the annual corporate income tax return.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China applies a substance-over-form doctrine and General Anti-Avoidance Rules under Article 47 of the EITL and Article 120 of the Implementation Regulations. A WFOE engaged in laser cutting and assembly of wooden puzzles must demonstrate substantial manufacturing operations in China, including customs records, payroll, production equipment, inventory, and warehouse premises, to support the performance of Core Income-Generating Activities (CIGA) and to resist treaty-shopping and GAAR recharacterization. The absence of real commercial substance may lead to denial of treaty benefits, recharacterization of related-party transactions, deemed dividends, and penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion through Fictitious Export and False VAT Export Rebates
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE fabricates export orders or uses false customs declarations for laser-cut wooden puzzle shipments, overstates export sales, or obtains VAT export rebates without actual goods crossing the border, thereby reducing taxable profits and converting revenue into rebates fraudulently.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 63 of the TCAL imposes a fine of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax; Article 204 of the Criminal Law (Export Rebate Fraud) prescribes imprisonment from 5 years up to life for serious fraud, plus confiscation of property. The STA will also revoke the export tax rebate qualification and require refund of all fraudulently received rebates with daily surcharges.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed the false declarations may be jointly and severally liable for restitution of fraudulent rebates and taxes. Travel bans may be imposed through the tax blacklisting system, suspending passport issuance and exit for non-resident directors. Criminal conviction can lead to 5 years to life imprisonment for the legal representative and finance director under the Criminal Law, with disqualification from management positions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Manipulation and Non-Disclosure of Related-Party Transactions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE artificially underprices exports to the foreign parent or Amazon-related entities, sets excessive royalties or management fees to shift profit offshore, fails to file the Related Party Transaction Reporting Form, and fails to prepare the Local File or Master File despite exceeding the RMB thresholds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under EITL Articles 41-48 and STA Public Notice 42 (2016), the tax authority may adjust income, disallow inflated deductions, and assess additional interest on the transfer pricing adjustment (benchmark lending rate plus up to 5 percentage points). Failure to file related-party returns attracts statutory fines under TCAL Article 62; deliberate adjustment procedures include a 10-year lookback and a gross-margin audit of the whole profitable chain.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be personally ordered to cover the corporate underpaid tax if assets were commingled or funds were extracted without lawful distribution, piercing the corporate veil under Article 20 of the Chinese Company Law. Directorial criminal liability arises where the conduct is part of a scheme to evade tax, leading to criminal prosecution for the planning accountant and CFO. The foreign parent may be blacklisted as a serious tax-violation enterprise, and non-resident directors may be prohibited from re-entering China.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company with No Economic Substance and Treaty Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE is registered only as a tax-transparent pass-through for dividends to the non-resident parent, maintains no actual laser-cutting equipment, employees, production records, or decision-making functions, while claiming treaty benefits on outbound dividends and royalties, and engages in circular financing or round-tripping transactions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority may apply the substance-over-form principle, recharacterize the WFOE as having a permanent establishment of the overseas parent, impute profits to the Chinese operation, deny the DTA dividend reduction under the Principal Purpose Test (BEPS Action 6), and assess additional tax, interest and penalties of up to 500% of the unpaid tax. The WFOE may also face administrative deregistration and cancellation of the foreign shareholder's treaty rights.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who orchestrate the shell structure risk personal civil liability for all underpaid taxes and customs duties under the Company Law's veil-piercing provisions; the STA and Customs jointly issue blacklisting decisions that freeze bank accounts, impose travel bans, and invalidate export approvals. In criminal cases, the courts may impose up to 7 years of imprisonment for tax-related fraud where economic losses are substantial, and the directors will be jointly liable to compensate the State for the full amount of taxes evaded.
